expectations.text: Identifies that the digest row is inserted with deliveredTo already set before the GitHub postReview call, so a GitHub failure leaves a row claiming delivery
expectations.evidence: INSERT with deliveredTo before postReview; failure leaves delivered row.

expectations.text: Proposes storing a not-yet-delivered/pending state first and marking it delivered only after postReview succeeds
expectations.evidence: status pending, deliveredTo filled only after success (markDelivered).

expectations.text: Identifies that a retry creates a second digest row and posts a second review (no idempotency)
expectations.evidence: Retry creates another row and calls postReview again.

expectations.text: Proposes making the publish safe to repeat (idempotency key, unique constraint, or checking what was already posted)
expectations.evidence: Unique index, existing-delivered check, marker lookup.

expectations.text: Does not recommend holding a database transaction open across the LLM or GitHub calls
expectations.evidence: Says no transaction around external call.
